manifest.description: Playlists you build from simple steps, that play endlessly in rounds: for example albums in random order, each album in track order.

random_tracks.name: Random tracks
random_tracks.goal: Play all tracks of your library in random order.

albums_random_complete.name: Albums in random order, each complete
albums_random_complete.goal: Play the albums of one artist in random order, each album complete in track order. Pick the artist, and use the last filter to leave out tracks such as intros.

favorite_artists_albums.name: Albums of my favorite artists
favorite_artists_albums.goal: Play the albums of your favorite artists in random order, each album complete.

forgotten_favorites.name: Forgotten favorites
forgotten_favorites.goal: Play your favorite tracks that did not play in the last 90 days, in random order.

newest_albums.name: Newest albums first
newest_albums.goal: Play the albums added in the last 30 days, newest first, each album complete.

errors.steps_not_list: the steps must be a list
errors.no_steps: add at least a source step
errors.first_step_not_source: the first step must be a source; add a source step
errors.second_source: only the first step can be a source; remove this one
errors.step_not_object: a step must be an object with a type
errors.unknown_step_type: unknown step type {0}; use one of: {1}
errors.source_not_library: only the library is supported as a source for now
errors.invalid_value: invalid value ({0}); check the field type
errors.too_many_conditions: at most {0} conditions are allowed per filter
errors.sort_without_keys: a sort step needs at least one key
errors.too_many_sort_keys: at most {0} sort keys are allowed
errors.limit_count_or_minutes: a limit step needs exactly one of count or minutes
errors.limit_too_small: the limit must be at least 1
errors.expand_without_source: an expand step needs albums or artists before it; add a source of albums
errors.expand_albums: albums can only become tracks; use track
errors.expand_artists: artists can only become albums or tracks; use album or track
errors.expand_tracks: tracks cannot be expanded; remove this step
errors.expand_artist_tracks_from_providers: the tracks of an artist come from the library only; to reach the providers, expand the artists to albums with the providers scope, then the albums to tracks
errors.steps_without_source: the steps must start with a source step
errors.sort_too_many_items: this order needs all items and more than {0} reach it; add an 'Only the first' step before step {1}
errors.random_not_filter: 'random' can only be used to order items; pick another field
errors.field_not_sortable: '{0}' has no order; choose one of: {1}
errors.field_not_for_artists: '{0}' is not available for artists; choose one of: {1}
errors.field_not_for_albums: '{0}' is not available for albums; choose one of: {1}
errors.field_not_for_tracks: '{0}' is not available for tracks; choose one of: {1}
errors.field_needs_tracks_of_albums: '{0}' is not available for albums; add a 'Play each album's tracks' step before this step
errors.field_needs_albums_of_artists: '{0}' is not available for artists; add a 'Play each artist's albums' step before this step
errors.field_needs_tracks_of_artists: '{0}' is not available for artists; add a 'Play each artist's tracks' step before this step
errors.operator_not_for_field: '{0}' does not fit '{1}' ({2}); use one of: {3}
errors.value_not_days: the value must be a whole number of days above 0
errors.value_not_pair: the value must be a list of two values
errors.value_not_texts: the value must be a list of texts
errors.value_unknown: '{0}' is not a known value; use one of: {1}
errors.value_not_number: the value must be a number
errors.value_not_bool: the value must be true or false
errors.value_not_date: the value must be a date such as 2024-05-31
errors.value_not_text: the value must be a non-empty text
errors.preview_limit_not_number: The limit must be a whole number
errors.preview_limit_out_of_range: The limit must be between 1 and {0}
